newsitem.title: USA: PDS Financial gets $10 mln credit line.
newsitem.headline: PDS Financial gets $10 mln credit line.

text.p: PDS Financial Corp said it set a $10 million revolving credit facility with Heller Financial Inc, increasing PDS's revolving borrowing capability to $56 million.

PDS Financial, which provides financing and other financial services to casino operators and gaming equipment makers, said the facility will be used to expand its SlotLease and other leasing programs.
The company said its lease portfolio was increased to about $36 million as of May 31 from $5 million a year earlier.
"Our increased access to capital, coupled with our recently announced used gaming device division are significant positive developments for the company," Johan Finley, president, said in a statement.
"We remain committed to a long-term growth plan with an increasing lease portfolio and related increasing revenues and cash flow," he added.
